introHtml: For corporate gifts that combine portability with practicality, 14 oz travel lifestyle gifts hit a sweet spot. This size fits comfortably in a car cup holder or a backpack side pocket, making it ideal for commuters and travelers. The Sip and Step Gift Set, for example, pairs a 14 oz insulated bottle with a pedometer, encouraging healthy habits on the go. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or laser engraving for a polished look that employees and clients will use daily.
